data.narrative:
Alef Aeronautics is a Series A-stage transportation company that has raised $30M+ to date. The broader transportation sector includes six private peers at various stages (Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, FleetZero, REGENT Craft) and no public comparables, limiting traditional peer benchmarking.

The valuation analysis relied on stage-progression methodology as the primary quantitative anchor. Using total capital raised ($30M) as a proxy for post-money valuation at Series A, a 2.0x step-up multiplier—typical for progression to the subsequent funding round—yields an implied valuation of $60M. A peer-median approach was not applicable; while three same-sector peers exist, none met the minimum threshold of three datapoints across same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier filters required for statistical reliability.

The triangulated range is $51M (low) to $69M (high), with a median estimate of $60M. This analysis is based on a single methodology and therefore carries material uncertainty. Key sensitivities include the actual post-money valuation at the Series A close (which may differ from the $30M raised proxy), investor appetite for frontier transportation technologies, and regulatory pathway clarity for the company's product category. Additional comparable valuation data at similar stage and sector specificity would strengthen confidence in this range.
